summary: The Fed decided today and the tape did not like it. Everything ran up into the 2:00 pm ET decision, then sold off. NQ round-tripped from a 29,254 high to a 28,763 low and closed 28,974, flat on the day but below its trend stop. ES fell 0.55 percent to 7,554, December gold flipped its stop down and closed 4,302, and crude gave back yesterday's spike, down 3.32 percent to 102.02. VIX rose about 3 percent to 17.71. All four markets now sit below their trend stops.

event.name: FOMC rate decision and projections (August retail sales 8:30 am ET)
event.consensus: Target range 3.50 to 3.75 percent into the meeting; market split on a hold versus a small hike
event.actual: The FOMC decision and fresh projections landed at 2:00 pm ET. We read it by its market fingerprint rather than guessing the exact rate move, and the fingerprint was hawkish: stocks, gold, and crude all sold off after the release and VIX rose, the classic higher-for-longer reaction.
event.surprise: Broadly hawkish read. By the close NQ and ES were back under their trend stops and December gold and crude had flipped their stops down.
event.nqReaction: NQ broke up out of its opening range, ran to a 29,254 high, then reversed on the 2pm decision below NYVWAP 29,116 to a 28,763 low before closing 28,974, flat on the day but below its trend stop.
event.crossAsset: December gold ran to 4,414 then flipped its stop down to close 4,302, off 0.72 percent. Crude gave back yesterday's spike, down 3.32 percent to 102.02 and below its stop. MGC1! October closed 4,268.3. VIX up about 3 percent to 17.71.

risk.sizing: Keep size reduced. The Fed just flipped or held all four markets below their trend stops on a violent reversal bar, so the short-term trend has tipped lower but on event noise, not a clean trend. Do not chase the flip in either direction. Let tomorrow's cleaner tape confirm before adding trend risk.
risk.openRisk: The flipped stops are the line. NQ is below 29,149, ES below 7,594, December gold below 4,363, and crude below 104.23, so all four carry a with-trend short lean until they reclaim those stops on two hourly closes. Downside references are today's lows: NQ 28,763, ES 7,509, gold 4,273, crude 101.03, then the round numbers below. Upside references are the reclaim stops above, then the overnight highs (NQ 29,187) and psych levels (NQ 29,500, ES 7,700, gold 4,400). Gold is holding the 4,300 psych by a hair, so 4,300 and then 4,273 are the levels that decide whether the metal steadies or extends lower.
risk.note: Event risk steps down now that the Fed is behind us, but follow-through after a hawkish reaction can extend for a day or two. Weekly jobless claims print Thursday at 8:30 am ET. Keep size small until the trend stops are reclaimed or clearly lost. Not financial advice.

psychology: Today was the binary event we spent all week preparing for, and it did exactly what binary events do: it whipped. If you traded the run-up into 2:00 pm and got caught long on the reversal, that sting is the market teaching a lesson you already knew. The pros were not guessing the decision. They waited for the dust to settle and traded the reaction with a plan. Notice that NQ closed near flat after a 491 point swing. That is a coin-flip day dressed up as a trend, and forcing size into it is how good weeks turn into bad ones. Tomorrow the event risk is behind us and the tape usually gives cleaner information. Reset, review what the Fed reaction actually did to your levels, and trade the follow-through, not your feelings about the decision.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html: NQ opened into a tight 48 point range at the bell: high 29,130, low 29,082. Price broke up out of that range at 9:45 ET and ran to 29,254, then the 2:00 pm Fed reversed it, dropping below NYVWAP 29,116 to a 28,763 low and closing 28,974. In plain terms the market broke out, the Fed trapped the breakout, and price reversed all the way through the range to the downside. For Thursday the opening range resets fresh and the Fed is behind us, so all four HTA OPEN plays are eligible by calendar: BIR, HOF, MID, and BNC. Calendar: weekly initial jobless claims Thursday September 17 at 8:30 am ET, plus any follow-on Fed speak. Conditional and educational only.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long is off across the board. All four markets closed below their trend stops, so the momentum long filter is not armed anywhere and a fresh long would fight the tape. This is exactly the spot the filter is built for: it keeps you out of longs while the trend stops are flipped down after an event. Wait for a stop reclaim on two hourly closes before a momentum long is back on the table.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 29,096, close 28,974 sits about 1 sigma below the mean. Bands: plus 2 sigma 29,322, plus 1 sigma 29,209, minus 1 sigma 28,983, minus 2 sigma 28,870, minus 3 sigma 28,758. Sigma is very wide at about 113 today because the FOMC ran a huge swing. The one clean signal was the 28,763 low tagging the minus 3 sigma band at 28,758 and reverting about 200 points into the close, a textbook exhaustion reversion. Volume is unavailable on the continuous contract, so this is price only. With the bands this stretched, wait for them to re-settle before trusting a fresh fade tomorrow.
